skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the enterprise architecture development process, implement digital transformation and business restructuring projects.
Develop skills in analyzing, planning, and implementing digital transformation and business restructuring.
Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities, with organizational skills and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
Understand and explain enterprise architecture standards, implement TOGAF-based enterprise architecture development stages.
Understand and use ArchiMate modeling tool for enterprise architecture.
Analyze case studies of enterprise architecture development.
